grade_reason: 3 P1 findings exceed C-tier max_p1 threshold of 2

escalations.title: Handlebars RCE — code injection via express transitive dependency
escalations.root_cause: express@4.18.2 pulls in a vulnerable handlebars version; 8 known CVEs covering code injection, XSS, prototype pollution, and DoS
escalations.exploit_scenario: If any route processes user-supplied data through a Handlebars template, an attacker can inject arbitrary JavaScript via template expressions, enabling server-side code execution.
escalations.remediation: cd Source/Backend && npm update express  # pins to 4.22.2 (or 5.2.1 for major upgrade)

escalations.title: Vitest UI arbitrary file read and remote code execution
escalations.root_cause: vitest@2.0.5 direct dev-dependency; when the Vitest UI server is enabled, unauthenticated attackers on the same network can read or execute arbitrary files on the developer's machine
escalations.exploit_scenario: Any attacker reachable on the same network as the dev workstation (e.g., shared Wi-Fi, CI runner) can craft HTTP requests to the Vitest UI port to read source files, secrets, or execute arbitrary code.
escalations.remediation: cd Source/Frontend && npm update vitest  # pins to 3.2.6+

p1.title: Traceability enforcer excludes portal/ — verification gate is broken
p1.detail: source_dirs hardcoded to ["Source", "E2E"]; portal/ has 300 Verifies comments covering FR-033..069, FR-DUP-01..13, and FR-dependency-* IDs — all invisible to CI. Running the enforcer against any portal-targeting plan reports 100% failure even though code is fully traced.
p1.remediation: Add "portal" to source_dirs in tools/traceability-enforcer.py (one-line change), then re-run all four failing plans to confirm true coverage.

p2.title: Enforcer is single-plan by default — 7 of 8 active plans never checked
p2.detail: Auto-selects most-recently-modified Plans/*/requirements.md. Seven plans (all portal-targeting) silently skipped on every CI run. CLAUDE.md verification gate gives false PASS.
p2.remediation: Add --all-plans flag, or update CLAUDE.md gate to loop all plans. Depends on QO-001 fix first.

p2.title: FR-dependency ID mismatch — three inconsistent ID namespaces
p2.detail: Plan uses FR-dependency-schema/types; Source/ uses FR-dependency-service/endpoints/dispatch-gating; portal/ uses FR-dependency-linking/ready-check/cycle-detection. Enforcer also picks up prose data IDs (FR-0002, FR-0003) as phantom failures.
p2.remediation: Reconcile FR IDs across plan, Source/, and portal/. Tighten enforcer regex to exclude short numeric IDs in prose.

p2.title: Duplicate frontend test files — false coverage confidence
p2.detail: Root-level copies are stale; pages/ copies are canonical. One set may silently not run depending on Jest glob, creating false coverage assurance.
p2.remediation: Delete stale root-level copies (tests/WorkItemDetailPage.test.tsx, tests/WorkItemListPage.test.tsx). Confirm Jest glob. Run tests.

p2.title: UUID buffer overflow — missing bounds check in v3/v5/v6 generation
p2.root_cause: uuid@9.0.0 direct production dependency; missing bounds check when external buf argument is provided
p2.remediation: cd Source/Backend && npm update uuid  # 9.0.1 (safe patch) or 11.1.1+ (full fix)
